name: Dread Cyclone
body:
School evocation [air]; Level: sorcerer/wizard 9, storm knight 9, witch 9

Components: V,S,DF

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: Long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)

Effect: Cyclone 20 ft. wide at base, 50 ft. wide at top, and 50 ft. tall

Duration: 1 round per level

Saving Throw: Reflex negates; Spell Resistance: yes

This spell is identical to the whirlwind spell, but for the following: a dread cyclone can affect creatures up to size Huge; if the dread cyclone exceeds the spell’s range, it moves randomly for 1d6 rounds; those who fail their save and are suspended by the winds suffer 1d10 damage per round.
